title: Gently Spiced Sweet Potato Hummus
description: A creamy hummus blending roasted sweet potato and chickpeas with garlic, yogurt, lemon and a gentle hit of cayenne, cumin and smoked paprika.
ingredients: 200g fat-free Greek yogurt (plus extra if needed)
¼ tsp smoked paprika (plus extra to serve)
steps: Prick sweet potatoes and microwave 7 minutes OR bake at 200°C for 45 minutes until tender. Slice open; allow to cool.
Put chickpeas, garlic, yogurt, cayenne, smoked paprika, cumin, salt and lemon juice in a food processor.
Scoop cooled sweet potato flesh in; blend until smooth and creamy.
If too thick, add a little more yogurt. Serve topped with cumin seeds and extra smoked paprika if desired.
notes: Basic hummus can be customised: start with 400g can chickpeas, 1 garlic clove, 200g yogurt, 1 tsp salt, juice of ½ lemon — then add pickled jalapeños, roasted red peppers, wild garlic or any spice mix.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
